find_program(PATCH_EXECUTABLE NAMES patch REQUIRED)

set(BIK_TO_WEBM_FXC2_SOURCE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/repo/fxc2.cpp")
file(GLOB BIK_TO_WEBM_FXC2_PATCHES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/*.patch")

set(BIK_TO_WEBM_FXC2_BUILD_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/repo")
set(BIK_TO_WEBM_FXC2_PATCHED_SOURCE "${BIK_TO_WEBM_FXC2_BUILD_DIR}/fxc2.cpp")
set(BIK_TO_WEBM_FXC2_EXECUTABLE "${BIK_TO_WEBM_FXC2_BUILD_DIR}/fxc2.exe")

add_custom_command(
	OUTPUT
		"${BIK_TO_WEBM_FXC2_EXECUTABLE}"
	BYPRODUCTS
		"${BIK_TO_WEBM_FXC2_PATCHED_SOURCE}"
	COMMAND
		"${CMAKE_COMMAND}"
		"-DSOURCE_FILE=${BIK_TO_WEBM_FXC2_SOURCE}"
		"-DPATCH_FILES=${BIK_TO_WEBM_FXC2_PATCHES}"
		"-DOUTPUT_DIR=${BIK_TO_WEBM_FXC2_BUILD_DIR}"
		"-DOUTPUT_FILE=${BIK_TO_WEBM_FXC2_PATCHED_SOURCE}"
		"-DPATCH_EXECUTABLE=${PATCH_EXECUTABLE}"
		-P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/ApplyPatch.cmake"
	COMMAND
		"${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}"
		-static
		"${BIK_TO_WEBM_FXC2_PATCHED_SOURCE}"
		-o "${BIK_TO_WEBM_FXC2_EXECUTABLE}"
	DEPENDS
		"${BIK_TO_WEBM_FXC2_SOURCE}"
		${BIK_TO_WEBM_FXC2_PATCHES}
		"${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/ApplyPatch.cmake"
		"${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_FILE}"
	COMMENT
		"Building fxc2"
	VERBATIM
)

add_custom_target(bik_to_webm_fxc2_build DEPENDS "${BIK_TO_WEBM_FXC2_EXECUTABLE}")
add_executable(bik_to_webm_fxc2 IMPORTED GLOBAL)
set_target_properties(bik_to_webm_fxc2 PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${BIK_TO_WEBM_FXC2_EXECUTABLE}")
add_dependencies(bik_to_webm_fxc2 bik_to_webm_fxc2_build)
